# Rack kit

One style of rack as a kit of named parts, in `danbyte/racks/kits/<Vendor>/<NAME>/kit.yaml` (export spec §14). Danbyte builds every rack of that style from the parts, to the rack's own height, width and depth: `post:segment` repeated per U, beams and panels stretched, doors swung on their `hinge` empty. Pathways (`path:`, `entry:`, `channel:0u:` empties) live in the kit model.

Schema: [`danbyte/schema/rack-kit.schema.json`](../../schema/rack-kit.schema.json) (danbyte-library/v1).

Files: `danbyte/racks/kits/<Vendor>/<NAME>/kit.yaml`. Start each with the editor line, so VS Code (YAML extension) completes and checks keys as you type:

```yaml
# yaml-language-server: $schema=<relative path to>/danbyte/schema/rack-kit.schema.json
```

## Keys

| Key | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `format` | [format](common.md#format) |  | The library format this file is written for. Optional; the tools write it, and a later format will change the value. |
| `name` | string | yes | The kit's name, equal to its folder (`CABINET`, `OPEN-4POST`). |
| `frame` | one of `cabinet`, `4-post`, `2-post`, `wall-cabinet` | yes | The frame type the kit builds. |
| `model3d` | mapping | yes | The kit model (every part as a named object; ≤ 20,000 unique triangles) and its far box (≤ 2,000). |
| `widths_mm` | list of integer (100–3000) |  | Outer widths the kit is meant for, mm. |
| `depths_mm` | list of integer (100–3000) |  | Outer depths the kit is meant for, mm. |
| `colours` | map of name → string (pattern) |  | Colour name → hex: base colours Danbyte may recolour the `FRAME` material to. |
| `comments` | string |  | What the kit's model shows and where its sizes come from. |
| `meta` | [meta](meta.md) |  | Catalog facts (see meta); category `rack-kit`. |

### model3d

The kit model (every part as a named object; ≤ 20,000 unique triangles) and its far box (≤ 2,000).

| Key | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `file` | [glbPath](common.md#glbpath) | yes | A binary glTF 2.0 file (`.glb`) under `danbyte/`, normally `assets/<Vendor>/<PART>.glb`. Stored with Git LFS. |
| `far` | [glbPath](common.md#glbpath) |  | A binary glTF 2.0 file (`.glb`) under `danbyte/`, normally `assets/<Vendor>/<PART>.glb`. Stored with Git LFS. |

Example:

```yaml
name: CABINET
frame: cabinet
model3d: {file: assets/Generic/CABINET.kit.glb, far: assets/Generic/CABINET.far.glb}
widths_mm: [600, 800]
depths_mm: [1000, 1200]
colours: {black: '#1b1c1e'}
```
